name: Snapping Turtle Style
prerequisites: Improved Unarmed Strike, base attack bonus +1 or monk level 1st
benefit:
While using the Snapping Turtle Style feat with at least one hand free, you gain a +1 shield bonus to AC.
## Combat Trick (from the Combat Stamina feat)
**Source** Pathfinder Unchained pg. 132
When using this style, as long as you have at least 1 stamina point in your stamina pool, your shield bonus to AC increases by 1.
flavor: Your deft unarmed style allows you to shield your body from harm.
